dependency_boundary_policy: Audit actual source, build/link rules and staged library symbols/NEEDED edges. Exclude a supporting dependency from OpenSSL migration only with evidence that it has no reachable OpenSSL API use and no libssl/libcrypto linkage. If positive or unknown, extend the audited dependency closure; do not edit unrelated components.

global_baseline.description: Traceability set only: 68 EasyMesh-derived API candidates are not 68 approved source edits. The migration-required set is generated from target-preprocessed ACTIVE call sites; EXCLUDED_WITH_EVIDENCE entries remain traceable and do not trigger source changes.
global_baseline.origin: The 68 API candidates were discovered from EasyMesh source inventory (WAPP/1905daemon call/reference scans) and cross-checked against the complete OpenSSL 1.1.1w/3.5.9 public-header sets.
